name: A Writer's Muse
source:
A short visual novel about a struggling writer and a barista who is more than he appears!

[Edited from [url=https://maxiewaxiewoo.itch.io/a-writers-muse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇視覺小說，講述一名為寫作發愁的作家，與一名遠比表面看起來更不簡單的咖啡師的故事！

（整理自[url=https://maxiewaxiewoo.itch.io/a-writers-muse]itch.io[/url]）
